title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends heartfelt greetings to all on ‘World Sanskrit Day’
subtitle:
Sanskrit language—the foundational basis of India's knowledge tradition, culture, and consciousness—is as scientific as it is ancient
The Vedas, Upanishads, and Shastras written in Sanskrit have been guiding humanity along the path of knowledge for centuries
I pay my respects to all the scholars and teachers who have made unforgettable contributions to preserving the Sanskrit language and passing it on to the new generation
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends Raksha Bandhan greetings to the people of the country on the occasion of Sawan Purnima
body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends heartfelt greetings to all on ‘World Sanskrit Day’.
In his post on X platform, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Sanskrit language—the foundational basis of India's knowledge tradition, culture, and consciousness—is as scientific as it is ancient. He said that the Vedas, Upanishads, and Shastras written in Sanskrit have been guiding humanity along the path of knowledge for centuries. Shri Shah said that I pay my respects to all the scholars and teachers who have made unforgettable contributions to preserving the Sanskrit language and passing it on to the new generation.
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extends Raksha Bandhan greetings to the people of the country on the occasion of Sawan Purnima.
सर्वेभ्यः ‘विश्वसंस्कृतदिवसस्य’ हार्दिक्य: शुभकामनाः। भारतस्य ज्ञानपरम्परायाः, संस्कृतेः, चेतनायाश्च मूलाधारभूता संस्कृतभाषा यावती प्राचीना, तावती एव वैज्ञानिकदृष्ट्या समृद्धा अपि अस्ति। संस्कृते रचिताः अस्माकं वेदाः, उपनिषदः, शास्त्राणि च शताब्देभ्यः मानवजातेः ज्ञानमार्गं… — Amit Shah (@AmitShah) August 28, 2026

enrichment.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of World Sanskrit Day, praising Sanskrit as the foundational basis of India's knowledge tradition and culture, and honoring scholars who preserved the language. He also extended Raksha Bandhan greetings on the occasion of Sawan Purnima.
enrichment.context: World Sanskrit Day is observed annually on Shravan Purnima to celebrate the Sanskrit language and its contribution to Indian philosophy, literature, and science. This release is a ceremonial greeting message from the Home Minister with no policy announcement, scheme, or new initiative attached.
